fields.name: idleTimeout
fields.description:
Idle timeout for the client connection. Upon timeout, `onIdleTimeout` resource (if defined)
in the server service will be triggered. Note that this overrides the `timeout` config
in the `websocket:Listener`, which is applicable only for the initial HTTP upgrade request

fields.name: maxFrameSize
fields.description:
The maximum payload size of a WebSocket frame in bytes.
If this is not set or is negative or zero, the default frame size, which is 65536 will be used

fields.name: validation
fields.description: Enable/disable constraint validation

fields.name: dispatcherKey
fields.description: The key which is going to be used for dispatching to custom remote functions.

fields.name: dispatcherStreamId
fields.description: The identifier used to distinguish between requests and their corresponding responses in a multiplexing scenario.

fields.name: connectionClosureTimeout
fields.description:
Time to wait (in seconds) for the close frame to be received from the remote endpoint 
before closing the connection. If the timeout exceeds, then the connection is terminated even though a close frame is
not received from the remote endpoint. If the value is -1, then the connection waits until a close frame is
received, and any other negative value results in an error. If the WebSocket frame is received from the remote endpoint
within the waiting period, the connection is terminated immediately.

constraints.message: onMessage and onTextMessage cannot coexist, onMessage already receives text frames.
onMessage and onBinaryMessage cannot coexist, onMessage already receives binary frames.

handlerTemplates.description: A custom dispatched handler. When the service config sets a dispatcherKey, the value of that field in an inbound message picks the handler by name: the value is camel cased and prefixed with on, so an event of "heartbeat" reaches onHeartbeat. A DispatcherConfig annotation overrides that derivation with an explicit dispatcherValue. A message matching nothing falls back to onMessage, or is ignored when that is absent too.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The inbound message, bound to the declared type.

handlerTemplates.description: A custom error handler, paired to a dispatched handler by name: that handler's name plus Error, so onHeartbeat pairs with onHeartbeatError. It receives the binding failure for that message type. Without it the failure falls back to onError.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

parameters.name: err
parameters.description: The failure that prevented the message from binding.

methods.name: onOpen
methods.description: Invoked once, after the handshake completes and the connection is established.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Invoked for every inbound message, text or binary alike. Declaring this handler rules out onTextMessage and onBinaryMessage, it already covers both. It is also the fallback for a custom message type that matched no dispatched handler.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The inbound message. A text frame deserializes straight to the declared type. A binary frame is read as bytes and then deserialized, unless the declared type is byte[]. A binding failure closes the connection with status 1003.

methods.name: onTextMessage
methods.description: Invoked for every inbound text frame.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text frame's content.

methods.name: onBinaryMessage
methods.description: Invoked for every inbound binary frame.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The binary frame's content.

methods.name: onPing
methods.description: Invoked when the peer sends a ping frame. Declaring it makes replying your responsibility, without it the library sends the pong automatically.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The ping frame's application data.

methods.name: onPong
methods.description: Invoked when the peer sends a pong frame, normally in reply to a ping this service sent.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The pong frame's application data.

methods.name: onIdleTimeout
methods.description: Invoked when no message has arrived for the idleTimeout set in the service config. The listener's own timeout does not trigger it, that one covers only the initial upgrade request.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Invoked when a close frame arrives from the peer.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for this connection, already closing, sends will not reach the peer.

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: The WebSocket close status code the peer sent.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The human-readable close reason the peer sent.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Invoked when the connection fails, always preceded by a connection closure with the matching close frame. Also the fallback for a binding failure when no matching custom error handler is declared.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for sending messages back over this connection.

parameters.name: err
parameters.description: The failure that interrupted the connection.
